mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening consumer demand and construction activity, which typically precedes higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals tightening monetary policy, compressing equity valuations through higher discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal a tightening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling does not produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening economic activity and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, INDPRO declines do not lead to negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL) typically triggers expectations of tighter monetary policy, increasing real interest rates and compressing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tight labor market, driving wage growth and consumer spending, which typically produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal robust consumer demand, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS rising does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery regimes, sustained growth in real GDP (GDPC1) signals improving economic conditions, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In post-recession recovery periods, GDPC1 growth does not lead to positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases.
